title: Signal: Legacy TLS protocol enabled in the server configuration in nginx — review required
scope: Single-line match on a legacy protocol in ssl_protocols in nginx.
limitations: Lexical: reads one directive line; an included snippet that overrides it is out of scope.

examples.line: # audit: ssl_protocols TLSv1 TLSv1.1 TLSv1.2; present

fpNotes: A documented legacy-client listener isolated to a private network is the accepted exception.
